title: O Último Trem
author: Exemplo da skill /manga
setting: modern Tokyo at night, around midnight

characters.name: Kaito
characters.look: 17-year-old Japanese boy, messy spiky black hair, sharp determined eyes, small bandage on his right cheek, black high-school gakuran uniform with open collar, long red scarf, slim athletic build

characters.name: Mei
characters.look: 17-year-old Japanese girl, long straight platinum-white hair with blunt bangs and a small crescent-moon hairclip, calm half-lidded eyes, navy sailor school uniform with a white ribbon, slender

panels.prompt: Establishing shot of a dense Tokyo cityscape at night with an elevated train line, a commuter train with glowing windows crossing the frame, quiet streets, neon signs without readable text
panels.shot: wide establishing shot, slightly high angle

panels.prompt: Kaito sprinting down the stairs of a train station, scarf flying behind him, sweat drops, desperate face, motion blur speed lines
Extreme close-up of a station wall clock showing 11:58, a single drop of sweat falling in the foreground
Empty train platform at night, a single train waiting with its doors starting to close, warning lights flashing
panels.shot: wide shot along the platform, one-point perspective

panels.prompt: Kaito screaming while running, arm stretched forward, intense eyes, scarf whipping
panels.shot: close-up, slightly from below, foreshortened hand toward camera

panels.prompt: Mei inside the train calmly stopping the closing doors with one hand, looking out at the viewer with a slight mysterious smile
panels.shot: medium close-up through the closing doors

panels.prompt: Kaito diving through the train doors and crashing onto the train floor, exhausted, while Mei stands above him looking down
panels.shot: wide dynamic diagonal shot inside the train car

panels.prompt: Kaito sitting on the train bench catching his breath, head tilted back, relieved

bubbles.text: Valeu... Se eu perdesse esse trem, minha mãe me matava.

panels.prompt: Mei sitting across, chin resting on her hand, calm unreadable smile, train windows dark behind her
Train window: the city lights outside abruptly disappear into total darkness, reflection of the empty car on the glass
panels.shot: narrow horizontal strip, close on the window

panels.prompt: Kaito suddenly tense, staring at the station display above the door with growing horror; behind him Mei keeps smiling, her eyes hidden in shadow

bubbles.text: Peraí... como ela sabe meu nome?

panels.prompt: The train arrives at an impossible ghostly station: endless rows of red torii gates, floating paper lanterns, mist, a giant pale moon; Mei stands on the platform turning back toward the viewer with an eerie gentle smile, her white hair glowing
panels.shot: grand splash page, low angle, epic scale
